issue.title: Relay re-registration returns generic 400 for same-wallet x402 URLs; stale terms cannot be refreshed

reason: Direct relay re-registration was retried using the documented externalUrl+POST+verificationBody pattern with no priceCents and still returned generic HTTP 400 for Capture, Preflight, and Guarded Action Pilot. Public source inspection indicates an existing sellerId can block re-claim even when the live x402 payTo wallet is identical. The issue requests a same-wallet reclaim/refresh path or an explicit actionable conflict response.
revenue_boundary: No funds moved, no wallet signature performed, no fee paid, and no customer revenue recognized.
